t: Houthis Report Attacks on Oil Refineries, Airports in Saudi Arabia
d: Yemen's Ansar Allah movement, also known as the Houthis, attacked two oil refineries and two airports in Saudi Arabia, Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said on Thursday.

t: Russia Needs Not Truce, But Peace in Ukraine - Kremlin Spokesman Peskov
d: Russia needs not a truce in the Ukraine conflict, but a long-term peace settlement, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said.

t: Lavrov Arrives in Atlanta to Attend Meeting of G20 Foreign Ministers
d: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has arrived in Atlanta to attend a meeting of G20 foreign ministers, scheduled for October 30–31, a RIA Novosti correspondent reported.

t: Russia Pulverizes Ukraine’s Military Logistics, Energy and Port Infrastructure – MoD
d: Russia carried out a strike on a power substation in Hotov which ensured the functioning of the military industry of Ukraine in Kiev, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Friday.

t: Ceasefire in Alyoshki Humanitarian Mission Zone Holds - Russian Ombudswoman
d: The regime of silence in the humanitarian mission area in Alyoshki remains in place, and no incidents have been recorded, Russian Human Rights Commissioner Yana Lantratova said on Friday.

t: FSB Detains Sevastopol Resident Suspected of Passing Russian Military Site Info to Ukraine
d: A Sevastopol resident has been detained on suspicion of treason for transferring data on Russian military facilities to Ukrainian terrorists, the Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) said on Friday.

d: Ukraine lost over 2,400 soldiers in combat against Russia's Battlegroup Tsentr over the past week, in addition to losses in manpower and equipment on other fronts, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Friday.
